description: NOVA RIDE edge v2 stereo (Kris, 2026-11-27: the edge must sit in the same stereo field as the other articulations). BOW, BOW2, BELL and BELL2 share a band-by-band left/right pattern (about 1.5-1.9 dB per band); the edge, whose energy is spread over hundreds of modes the bow and bell barely use, came out centred in every band (0.5 dB). Each mode listed here is one the edge plays and bow and bell barely touch (40 dB or more below their strongest mode, and the edge at least 10x stronger than bow and bell on it); it takes the stereo picks (pick_l, pick_r) of one of its band's 8 strongest bow/bell modes, drawn in proportion to their bow/bell energy (seed 27). Indices are in the final 2304-mode order (nova_edge_v2_modes.json); nova_index is the NOVA index (-1 for an added mode). Result: the edge within 0.41-0.65 dB of the bow/bell pattern (before 0.79-1.33; the bow/bell rows among themselves 0.27-0.52); BOW and BELL change only in stereo, by 21-37 dB below the signal.
